headline: Meta's longtime infrastructure head Santosh Janardhan is stepping down
body: Meta told TechCrunch that Santosh Janardhan, its longtime head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering, will step down. Dave Brown, who joined as vice president of infrastructure earlier this year, will replace him. Meta says Janardhan will stay on for a transition.
note: The role covers Meta Compute, the effort to scale data center investment, and PYMNTS reports Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures of $135 billion to $145 billion.

evidence.text: Santosh Janardhan, the company’s longtime head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering, will be stepping down, Meta told TechCrunch.
He will be replaced by Dave Brown, who joined the company as vice president of infrastructure earlier this year, the company added.
It sounds like Janardhan will remain at Meta for a little bit, although he is expected to leave next year.
Earlier this year, Janardhan was tasked with leading Meta Compute , the company initiative to scale its data center investments and strategy.

The company said during its third-quarter earnings report that it expects 2026 capital expenditures of $135 billion to $145 billion, reflecting investments in data centers, computing equipment and supporting infrastructure.
“Santosh will stay on for transition and he is moving into an advisory role on Meta Compute,” said a Meta representative.
